notes: NEW layout: the Study and Lecture tabs now use side panels like the Lab — on a wide screen your material sits in a panel on the left with the study pack beside it, and your lecture notes sit beside the lecture controls. On a phone, one panel shows at a time with tabs to switch (Your material / Study pack, Lecture / Your notes).

The panels appear when they have something to show: the study-pack panel opens beside your material once a pack is generated, and the notes panel opens beside the lecture once notes are made. On a phone, generating a pack jumps you to it, and making notes jumps you to them.
Nothing else changed: the detector (V20), study packs, tutor rules, and Ollama connection are untouched.
